projects.title: Brava : Company Profile & CMS
projects.summary: A corporate website connected to a custom content management system.
projects.description: A client project combining a public-facing company profile website with a Laravel-powered CMS for managing website content.
projects.problem: The client needs a professional company website and a manageable way to update content without editing source code.
projects.solution: A Next.js frontend consumes a Laravel REST API, while the CMS provides content-management workflows for authorized editors.
projects.contribution: Contributed across frontend and backend development, API integration, CMS functionality, and client-facing problem solving.

visual.alt: Preview diagram of the Brava corporate website and content management system

projects.title: SM Sport Center : Online Court Booking
projects.summary: A futsal court booking platform with online reservation and payment integration.
projects.description: A client project in development to help customers reserve futsal courts and manage booking and payment flows online.
projects.problem: The venue needs a more convenient way for customers to book courts and complete payment online.
projects.solution: A web-based booking workflow is being developed with payment gateway integration.
projects.contribution: Contributed to full-stack implementation and integration work.

visual.alt: Preview diagram of a futsal court booking interface

projects.title: Donelock : Productivity App
projects.summary: A mobile productivity app concept for organizing tasks, notes, and schedules.
projects.description: A Flutter-based productivity application project exploring task organization, notes, calendar experiences, and Firebase integration.
projects.problem: Users often struggle with disjointed note and task applications that create cognitive friction.
projects.solution: A streamlined mobile interface prioritizing fast capture, clear priority tagging, and date organization.
projects.contribution: Designed UI flows and implemented core task state management.

visual.alt: Preview diagram of the mobile productivity application
